text.zh: 从递推式 aₙ₊₁ = p·aₙ + qⁿ 出发，先用待定系数法构造等比数列 bₙ = aₙ + qⁿ / (p − q)，求出通项 aₙ = (a₁ + q / (p − q))·pⁿ⁻¹ − qⁿ / (p − q)。再追问这种「变换系数」的做法背后是什么：借复数和 2×2 矩阵的对应引出线性变换，把递推写成状态向量乘矩阵 sₙ₊₁ = A·sₙ，由 Aⁿ⁻¹ 算出同一个通项。
text.en: Starting from the recurrence aₙ₊₁ = p·aₙ + qⁿ, the method of undetermined coefficients builds the geometric sequence bₙ = aₙ + qⁿ / (p − q) and gives aₙ = (a₁ + q / (p − q))·pⁿ⁻¹ − qⁿ / (p − q). The post then asks what this juggling of coefficients really is: by writing complex numbers as 2×2 matrices it arrives at linear maps, rewrites the recurrence as a state vector times a matrix, sₙ₊₁ = A·sₙ, and gets the same formula out of Aⁿ⁻¹.
